title: CrewAI: Declarative Agent Roles
description: Agents defined by plain-English role, goal, and backstory, with sequential task execution and implicit data passing.

steps.description: Agent definitions: Researcher with web search tool, Drafter as technical writer, Critic as demanding editor.
Researcher: role, goal for finding passages, backstory as rigorous academic, and SerperDevTool.
Drafter and Critic: Drafter writes responses from passages, Critic identifies gaps and weaknesses.
Task definitions that bind agents to descriptions and expected outputs.
Task_r: Researcher task takes question, produces 3-5 passages with sources.
Task_d and task_c: Drafter consumes passages, Critic consumes draft, each with specific output formats.
Crew assembly: agents list, tasks list, sequential process, and kickoff with question input.
